metadata.name: LinkedTransaction
metadata.description: This API is to get the list of linked transaction of any generated transaction to its original transaction and vice-versa of an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: TransactionId
request_fields.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXX Example:236547895

request_fields.name: TransactionSource
request_fields.description: Source of Transaction made like ACH, manual etc Valid Values:0-9,a-z Format : Manual Example:Manual, ACH Allowable Values: 50

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for the  transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 a-z Format:XXXXXXXX Example:23654789 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionDateTime
children.description: Date and Time of transaction occured Valid Values:0 - 9 Format:MM:DD:YYYY HH/MM/SS Example:12:11:2020 11/00/00

children.name: PostDateTime
children.description: This is the time when transaction actually got posted in system. Valid Values: valid date Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 12:10:01

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Format: xxxxxxxx Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: TransactionSource
children.description: Source of Transaction made like ACH, manual etc Valid Values:0-9,a-z Format : Manual Example:Manual, ACH Allowable Values: 50

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: Current balance of account/Debtor Owing Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: Postingref
children.description: Posting reference (Like -Transaction Posted Successfully) Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: Transaction Posted Successfully Allowable Values: 100

children.name: BeginingBalance
children.description: Beginning Balance of an account before making any transaction on it. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.00 Example:400.00

children.name: CaseID
children.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXX Example:9856198
